name: g18 refusal — text-search FILTER (REGEX) is refused by name until capability-aware routing lands
sparql: PREFIX c: <urn:arango-sparql:concept#> SELECT ?url WHERE { ?ch a c:Chunk ; c:text ?t ; c:accountId ?acct . ?d a c:Document ; c:citableUrl ?url ; c:accountId ?acct . FILTER(REGEX(?t, "frustrated", "i")) }
